description: Variable shadowing and scoping in nested BEGIN...END blocks, run through EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $$...$$. Snowflake Scripting semantics: a variable declared in an outer scope is visible in inner blocks; a variable ASSIGNED (not declared) in an inner block updates the outer one; a variable DECLARED with LET or DECLARE inside a block shadows the outer one for that block only and is discarded when the block exits. Covers assignment propagation through one, two and three levels, shadowing that leaves the outer value untouched even after the shadow is reassigned, mixed shadow-and-assign in one block, sequential independent inner blocks, IF and IF-ELSE branches, and a FOR-over-cursor loop accumulating into an outer variable. Converted 1:1 from features/VariableShadowingTest (now retired).
